title: Single-/Multi-Channel Calibration
author: Opentrons
materials: Upload your protocol into the OT App.

steps.title: Attach correct pipette
steps.instruction: Mount the P300 Single‑Channel Pipette or the P300 Multi‑Channel Pipette on the OT‑2, depending on which calibration test you will run.

steps.title: Load labware and tips
steps.instruction: Place the custom tube holder (holding 500 µL tubes from Simport Scientific) on the deck and load Fisherbrand 2‑20 µL tip racks (e.g., in slot 1) and Fisherbrand 20‑200 µL tip racks in the appropriate slots.

steps.title: Configure protocol parameters
steps.instruction: In the OT‑2 Run App, set the protocol to use the attached pipette and define the following transfers:

substeps.instruction: If using the P300 Single‑Channel Pipette:
‑ Transfer 5 µL from well A1 to wells A2, A3, and A4 using a 2‑20 µL tip.
‑ Transfer 50 µL from well B1 to wells B2, B3, and B4 using a 20‑200 µL tip.
‑ Transfer 200 µL from well C1 to wells C2, C3, and C4 using a 20‑200 µL tip.
If using the P300 Multi‑Channel Pipette:
‑ Transfer 5 µL from column 1 to columns 2, 3, and 4 using a 2‑20 µL tip.
‑ Transfer 50 µL from column 5 to columns 6, 7, and 8 using a 20‑200 µL tip.
‑ Transfer 200 µL from column 9 to columns 10, 11, and 12 using a 20‑200 µL tip.

steps.title: Generate protocol file
steps.instruction: Enter any additional protocol parameters required by the app, then click “Download” to save the protocol file to your computer.

steps.title: Upload protocol to OT App
steps.instruction: In the OT‑2 Run App, use the “Upload” function to load the downloaded protocol file onto the robot.

steps.title: Set up deck according to map
steps.instruction: Arrange the deck exactly as shown in the protocol’s deck map: place the custom tube holder, tip racks, and any other required labware in the indicated slots.

steps.title: Calibrate labware and pipette
steps.instruction: Using the OT‑2 Run App, run the calibration routine to calibrate the labware, tip racks, and the attached pipette (refer to Opentrons support articles for calibration tips).

steps.title: Run the calibration protocol
steps.instruction: Press “Run” in the OT‑2 Run App to execute the defined transfers and complete the calibration test.
